scope: Ordinary song-action keyboard dismissal and queue action at1280×720 normal zoom
change: Track menus dismiss when focus leaves them. Outside scrolling only hides a still-open menu, so it cannot unconditionally override focus on the next row/control. Explicit Escape and action selection retain opener restoration.

method.application: Current production renderer/preload and actual source-bundled main/services/storage/HTTP/media with fresh protected dummy account and localhost catalog. Native window hidden/muted; shared Keychain/provider adapters substituted. No external or billed request.
method.before: At1280×720, keyboard-open the first song actions, End to Song details, then Tab. Native focus moves to the next TR while the old popup stays open.
method.after: Same forward Tab closes the popup and leaves focus on the exact next song. Shift+Tab from the first action closes to the trigger. Escape and external scrolling close and restore the trigger when focus was inside. ArrowDown/Enter on Add to queue appends only Song10000, retaining the prior duplicate queue/order/current index and paused intent.
method.sourceReview: Searched all renderer scroll-dismiss listeners. FilterSelect already uses conditional native dismissal after the preceding fix; TrackMenu was the remaining listener that unconditionally refocused its trigger. No new abstraction or dependency.
method.cleanup: Final native driver terminates zero, owned native close checks absence of captured fatal output, localhost server stops and control file resets. Zero provider calls.
method.baseline: Only1280×720 at normal zoom. No deferred smaller-window or enlarged-zoom check.

limits: This shared action-popup check does not establish full playlist permissions/mutations or all catalog-refresh behavior.
No VoiceOver, user-comprehension, live-provider or audible-quality claim. Earlier Q10 shutdown diagnostic remains open.
